reviewer: Claude Code (AI first-pass source audit; not an independent human curator)
scope: 1-based manifest positions 131-140 of data/validation/self_run_p0_candidates.json, frozen order; 10 candidates, 31 arms
blinding: self_run_p0_predictions.json and all model outputs NOT opened. FRDB snapshot /tmp/sisyphus-frdb-v2024-12-30.zip (SHA256 647b80d9...9c7a verified) read with every column containing 'cmax' dropped before any row was printed. Arms were mapped by dose, AUC, t1/2, n, sex and application/population/funbound comments only. Original-source Cmax values were then read from the original tables or text. Some abstracts print Cmax next to the mapping fields (ligustrazine 29882510); mapping there used AUC/t1/2 only and failed. No observed-vs-predicted comparison was made.
method_note: Single AI pass. Full originals read: the PMDA anagliptin review report A100 (PDF pp.35-45), the J-STAGE open-access PDF of Shen 2013 (ligustrazine), and the PMC4694390 HTML (clenbuterol). Closed originals were time-boxed to abstracts or landing pages: Li 2018 (Dustri), Hijazi 2004 (Wiley), Zhang 2009 talipexole (Wiley, redirected to abstract), Ghoneim 2010 (Elsevier), fluzoparib 2021 (T&F Get Access), Gardin 2009 CRA13 (DMD/ScienceDirect HTTP 403 / Cloudflare), Bialer 1990 (Springer), Emara 2000 (abstract sufficient for ineligibility). No email or contact-requiring API (e.g. Unpaywall) was used; only PubMed E-utilities (via MCP), Europe PMC, publisher pages, J-STAGE and PMDA were queried. Conventional tablets not worded IR are verified_with_caveat, following the 81-130 convention. Transient headless-browser files created by this pass in the gitignored .playwright-mcp/ were deleted; no repository file was modified.
unresolved_issues: Ligustrazine (33538): frdb_10885 is verified from the open full text (dose on a 108 mg TMP free-base basis = 200 mg TMPP). frdb_10889 (Li 2018) cannot be mapped: the FRDB AUC 1786.29 / t1/2 1.69 match neither the test nor the reference arm in the abstract. The full text (Dustri) is needed.
Valategrast (9033): all 7 arms are ineligible. The dosed drug is the R411 ester prodrug, and the FRDB analyte and manifest SMILES are its active metabolite RO0270608, not the dosed parent.

Anagliptin (8243): 8 of 13 arms are verified_with_caveat (DP0001 fasted 10-400 mg, DP0004 fasted 100 mg, and the renal and hepatic study healthy controls at 400 mg, which report geometric means). 5 arms are ineligible because they were dosed immediately before a meal (frdb_8128/8129/8130, and the DP0002 day-0 frdb_8131). Two 400 mg arms and one 100 mg arm come from different studies; the 400 mg DP0001 arm is an arithmetic mean and the foreign arms are geometric means.
Vincamine (6901): ineligible, because both products are prolonged-release preparations.
Clenbuterol (2625): ineligible, because the product is an ambroxol + clenbuterol fixed-dose combination tablet; its Cmax is also compartment-model derived.
Fluzoparib (59669): the title says tablet but the abstract says capsule; the full text is paywalled, so the fasted Cmax is unverified.

Paywalled originals needing library retrieval: 10.5414/CP203270 (ligustrazine arm mapping), 10.1111/j.1365-2710.2008.01008.x (talipexole dose/Cmax), 10.1016/j.bioelechem.2010.08.003 (nitroxoline; n=2 methods paper, likely weak), 10.1080/17425255.2021.1881480 (fluzoparib), 10.1124/dmd.108.024000 (CB-13 per-dose Cmax and dosage form), 10.1007/BF00315032 (valnoctamide formulation/fasting/Cmax).

arms.reason: Mapped by AUC0-inf 2715.6 and t1/2 1.49 (Table 1, tablet column). Parent TMP plasma Cmax after a single oral dose of TMPP tablets in fasted healthy men. Caveats: the tablet is a conventional marketed TMPP tablet that the introduction calls 'immediate-release oral tablets'; the dose is 200 mg TMPP salt (108 mg TMP free base, matching the manifest's 108 mg base); Table 1 says n=20, but the text says 18 completed the single-dose study.
